image_prompts.purpose: Week 9 opener board for bridging from Week 8 sewing actions into Week 9 patternmaking language.
image_prompts.visual_description: A compact adult-oriented patternmaking workspace board with clearly visible pattern paper, ruler, measuring tape, pencil, scissors, and one or two obvious paper pattern-piece clues on a clean studio table.
image_prompts.style_instructions: Use a polished fashion-education illustration or realistic studio-reference style with strong visual clarity and adult proportions.
image_prompts.composition_notes: Keep the objects separated and easy to scan on mobile. Emphasize the transition from sewing tools to paper pattern preparation rather than showing a full process sequence.
image_prompts.text_in_image: Only short visible keys if needed for the opener questions.
image_prompts.avoid: Avoid logos, dense clutter, childlike styling, tiny measurement markings, unsafe tool placement, and decorative backgrounds.

image_prompts.purpose: Pattern pieces and tools board for the main Week 9 patternmaking matching task.
image_prompts.visual_description: One clean educational board showing ten clearly different patternmaking examples. Visible key A is a generic pattern piece, B is pattern paper, C is front bodice, D is back bodice, E is sleeve, F is skirt front, G is waistband, H is pocket, I is ruler, and J is French curve.
image_prompts.style_instructions: Use a clear educational board style with simple pattern diagrams and unmistakable tool examples that remain readable on a phone screen.
image_prompts.composition_notes: Keep each key A to J large and easy to compare. Show the pattern pieces as clean paper shapes with high contrast and simple markings, and keep the tools visually distinct.
image_prompts.text_in_image: Only the visible keys A to J.
image_prompts.avoid: Avoid extra labels, decorative typography, duplicate-looking pattern shapes, and ambiguous tools that make the answer key uncertain.

image_prompts.purpose: Measurements and pattern marks board for the main Week 9 visual-matching task.
image_prompts.visual_description: One clean board combining simple body-measurement references and a basic pattern-piece diagram with visible pattern marks. Visible key A is bust, B is waist, C is hip, D is shoulder, E is armhole, F is grainline, G is fold line, H is seam allowance, I is notch, and J is dart.
image_prompts.style_instructions: Use a polished educational visual style with simple body references and one clear pattern-piece diagram that stays readable on mobile.
image_prompts.composition_notes: Separate the measurement and marking sections clearly. Make the difference between grainline, fold line, seam allowance, notch, and dart very easy to see with strong contrast and uncluttered spacing.
image_prompts.text_in_image: Only the visible keys A to J.
image_prompts.avoid: Avoid crowded layouts, decorative text, tiny marks, ambiguous arrows, or multiple overlapping pattern pieces.

image_prompts.purpose: Reading sequence board for tracing and labeling a simple pattern piece.
image_prompts.visual_description: A sequence board with six clearly separated patternmaking-process images labeled only A, B, C, D, E, and F. A shows pattern paper on a table, B shows one pattern piece placed on the paper, C shows tracing the outside line, D shows marking the grainline and fold line, E shows adding seam allowance, and F shows labeling the piece and checking the measurement.
image_prompts.style_instructions: Use a clean educational sequence-board style with one consistent workspace and one consistent paper pattern piece across all six images.
image_prompts.composition_notes: Keep the six steps easy to compare and scan in order on mobile. The same piece and table should appear across the sequence so the process feels continuous and credible.
image_prompts.text_in_image: Only the visible keys A to F.
image_prompts.avoid: Avoid busy backgrounds, changing the pattern piece shape between steps, extra instruction text, or step scenes that do not clearly match the reading text.

image_prompts.purpose: Reusable pattern-piece gallery for listening, writing, and speaking.
image_prompts.visual_description: A gallery with five clearly separated pattern-piece images labeled only image A, image B, image C, image D, and image E. Image A shows a front bodice piece with center front and dart, image B shows a back bodice piece with center back, image C shows a sleeve piece with notches and grainline, image D shows a skirt front piece on the fold with waistline, and image E shows a waistband piece with a straight grainline.
image_prompts.style_instructions: Use a polished fashion-studio instructional style with strong diagram clarity, adult learner context, and high-contrast pattern lines.
image_prompts.composition_notes: Keep the five images visually distinct and evenly spaced. The gallery must support exact answer-key matching across listening, writing, and speaking, so the same markings and labels should remain consistent across all uses.
image_prompts.text_in_image: Only the visible image keys A, B, C, D, and E.
image_prompts.avoid: Avoid extra decorative text, cluttered backgrounds, childlike styling, or pattern markings that contradict the Week 9 listening and writing flow.
